name: jtentor/moodle-enrol_mercadopagocpro
description: Moodle enrolment plugin that enrols students after payment through Mercado Pago Checkout Pro. NOTE: this file records how the bundled SDK under vendor/mercadopago/src was produced. Do NOT run composer install in this directory on a live site: it creates vendor/autoload.php, which sdk::register() prefers, so a second copy of the SDK would shadow the audited bundle. Development tools belong in the Moodle root vendor/.
